strings.en: Your fate.../　ends by my hand!
All that's left is to pull the trigger...!
I'll show you the power of the Bird of Ill Omen's kin.
Even if it's a Gadisword unit, I'll master it.
Don't think you can escape, So-Des.
That unit... Is Jua-Mu piloting it?
Jua-Mu.../　Neither of us can afford to lose here.
If I can bring down the Raftclans here...!
It's dangerous to close in carelessly.
That Raftclans is/　trying to keep its distance...!
You look every bit the assassin.
Same as you... I eliminate anything in my way.
Gu-Landon, you've run out of options...!
If there's a possibility... No, that's...!
The one controlling that unit is...
I can't rule out the possibility...
You'll pay for meddling with Earth too.
You must know what becomes of/　those who interfere with Earth.
I need to watch out for that Raig-Geios.
Iradoya, I won't be thrown off by your pace.
If that man belongs to/　Golaikunru's inner circle...!
I have to hurry to Rabulpaila...!
Vort Nikolaus, I have no business with you.
There's nowhere left to run, Reggiane.
To think they'd use the Cross Gate like that...!
Herluga, that power/　is more than you can handle.
Looks like I don't need precise aim.
So Dark Brain remnants still existed.
Debudedabide seems to be after/　the Kaana types alone...!
Debudedabide, you too will vanish into the darkness.
Even Zovorg units are being controlled...!
We won't yield to mere numbers.
To find the cause, I must avoid a direct hit.
Either way, they're still the enemy.
So they can even control Yokijin.
Even if you command the Lamaris...!
It looks just like its name.
Whatever it really is,/　right now it's nothing but a broken machine...!
I know how to deal with Zovorg units.
I'm used to fighting that unit.
You still seem to cling to Earth.
No matter how many times/　you come to Earth...!
I have no intention of joining your business.
You're not making use of your long range.
I'll take down the commander unit...!
If I can eliminate that Org-Valu...!
Getting inside the Zeidram's reach/　is dangerous, but...!
I know where its power plant is...!
Doesn't look like a Bioroid Soldier is piloting it.
Fury... I won't let you do as you please.
Thorn must be destroyed as top priority...!
From the look of it, that's the commander unit./　Then...!
You'll be clearing the way for me!
A Gasbra, is it? I'll take it down.
All I can do is destroy them one by one.
Even if they combine, my job is the same...!
The longer this drags on, the worse for us...!
All Kaana types will be annihilated.
Is that the Lamaris's final form...?!
To think I'd face the Ares Geist again.
I'm not the one who should be fighting you, but...
I have to draw it away from the Cross Gate quickly...!
Any more of this... is a waste of time.
Your lack of strength proved fatal...!
This is what comes of failing to finish me.
Where do you think you're going?
Looks like this is as far as I go...!
Ngh! Don't think that'll/　be enough to shoot me down!
Wh-What is this...!/　More power than I expected...!
If you don't finish me in one hit,/　you'll regret it.
Ngh! Still, this is getting interesting.
Interesting... I didn't think you'd go this far...!
I can't lose the unit Ingram/　entrusted to me...!
I-I can't let the engine/　explode here...!
Seems you got careless at the end, Gu-Landon...!
I won't play into Golaikunru's scheme!
There's no way they can master/　the Cross Gate's power...!
Do you claim to know my habits...?!
To think I'd be read this far ahead...!
The Kaana type's power is growing...?!
Not bad at all.../　I'll look forward to next time.
Heh, it's a shame you're my enemy.
It seems you can fight me as an equal.
Is that the extent of your ability?
If you mean to defeat me,/　make sure you finish me in one blow.
Half-hearted attacks are a waste of time.
Ngh! As long as the power source/　doesn't take a direct hit...!
The joint armor is double-layered... It'll hold.
I can't lose a valuable Gadisword unit...!
To think Jua-Mu would overpower me...!
Ngh, so this is a Knight's true skill...!
Getting this far through sheer brute force.../　So that's the Emperor Unit's power...!
That woman will be a wall...!
Don't think you can control/　the Cross Gate's power forever...!
Did its strange arts deceive me...?!
Crystal Dragoon... I won't let you go any further.
I see... That's one of your tricks too, Skull Knight.
Ngh! So this is the power of the deity ship!
It hits right where it hurts...!
It sees right through my movements...?!
And I've fought them so many times...!
Is the Fury pushing us back...?!
One slip and a single stroke will bring me down...!
If that's a mass of malice, then its source is...!
This is no time to struggle with that Lamaris...!
That power of the Ares Geist...!
I have no interest in playing with monsters!
If that's all you've got.../　you'd best leave my sight.
I'll give you credit/　for scratching my unit...
Heh... Did you just manage to hit me...?
Don't hold back. Come at me with everything.
Heh... There's no need to rush to your death.
And with that you dared to stand in my way.
I won't have you underestimating this R-GUN.
That's not enough to stop the Exbein.
Is that the end of it, Jua-Mu?
I couldn't shake off the Raftclans...!
Karo-Ran, cheap tricks won't bring me down.
Gu-Landon's confidence.../　Is he still just testing the waters?
You're not serious yet, are you, Gomoudokka?
You read my movements, didn't you, Vort?
That much speed from such a large unit...!
Using the Cross Gate's power,/　I doubt that's all it can do...
Is that the end of the entertainment?
I see those grandiose wings aren't just decoration.
I took your hit, Skull Knight.
XN-L... How much power are you hiding?
I read its movements, yet I couldn't dodge...?!
Are my moves being read? No, perhaps...
I'm not even in sync/　with that pilot, and yet...!
It doesn't seem to have been improved in any way.
Whatever the unit, the pilot's skill...
That Thick Cylinder is surprisingly fast.
Heh, a cut above the mass-produced ones.
I can't underestimate the mobility of their units.
To think the Lamaris would latch onto me...
I couldn't shake off the Kaana type.
It seems more than its appearance has changed.
Its movements are hard to predict...!
If it's humanoid, the basics are mostly the same.
Your aim is precise... which makes it easy to read.
I thought you were one of Gadisword's best?
As long as the Siebe Drive remains,/　this is only a stopgap...!
It may look fast, but that won't do.
Even worse to deal with than Dark Brain.
This feeling, like we're in sync...
How many times have I fought that unit...
Seems that unit is too much for you.
Not much different from Zovorg units.
The Fury's skill isn't all that impressive.
So you'll close off your own path to survival...
I sympathize with your circumstances, but...
You're not the only ones/　who excel at space combat.
I can't let that latch onto me.
Its ferocity grows as it changes.
Ares Geist, just pushing forward won't do...!
As expected, its mobility is lacking.
Next time, aim for someone else.
I'll look forward to next time.
Unless you get serious,/　you won't bring down the Bird of Ill Omen.
Only cheap tricks after all, So-Des.
Gu-Landon,/　you're doing nothing but talk about ambition.
Not pursuing too far.../　A surprisingly cautious foe.
You're certainly beyond human understanding./　But you're not invincible.
In a way, we're in sync... This is...
I can't drop my guard against that unit.
Kaana type... I need to be careful.
I won't take a direct hit.
You don't have to be so scared...
Not while you stand there frozen.
Radha, leave the rest to me.
Ryusei, leave the rest to me.
Ryusei, make your attacks more precise.
Mai, leave the rest to me.
I'll back you up, Major Gilliam.
I'll back you up, Lieutenant Kyosuke.
Excellen, leave the rest to me.
Rio, I'll take it from here.
Major Kai, leave the rest to me.
Arieil, leave the rest to me.
Lüne, leave the rest to me.
Leave the rest to me, Lieutenant Calvina.
Akemi, leave the rest to me.
To Steel 2. Moving in to support!
To Dragon 2. Moving in to support!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
Even if it costs me my life!
Your evasion's sloppy. Extra training later.
Arado... You need extra training too.
Lieutenant Yon, I'll take this one!
That position will be your undoing!
I've had you in my sights all along!
System connect! Captain, leave the rest to me!
I'll leave it to you, Aya.
T-Link Full Contact!/　Metal Genocider Mode, activate!
There's no escape for you now.
Not a single one gets away!
...I did use a bit too much ammo there.
I won't strike the same spot twice!
Behold the gleam of the twin baleful stars.
The baleful quarter has claimed you.
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
For my fee, I'll take some mysterious shades!
You were already under the star of ill omen...
I'll punch through with the Cylion!
